ciparitygate names its marker literals in one place; releasepreflight has no literal copy of a ciwatch constant
fix: Add TestConclude_MissingLinkIsFailNeverWarn, TestRequiredEvidence_IsSortedAndDeterministic and TestRenderCommandStub_MultiLineDescriptionRoundTripsWithoutDrift, then delete the three comments; move withLink into a _test.go file; name every ciparitygate marker literal in one table; use the ciwatch constants in releasepreflight; point cycle1707's prose at the design notes instead of the deleted comment.
summary: Comment round 12 (PR #749) kept three comments that state a rule no test pins: auditchain's missing link is a FAIL, never a WARN; auditchain's RequiredEvidence is sorted and deterministic; skillcheck's multi-line command description round-trips without drift. auditchain's withLink (auditchain.go) is production code that only tests call. ciparitygate's offenders.go names some marker literals in a table and spells others inline, and releasepreflight repeats "success"/"completed" instead of ciwatch.ConclusionSuccess/StatusCompleted. acs/cycle1707's prose points at a doc comment in fingerprint.go that round 12 deleted.
title: Round 12 leftovers: pin three kept whys with tests, move auditchain's test-only helpers, and unify two duplicated literal sets
